comparison.objective: Hold a sprung picture-frame back flush while turning four retaining clips.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual preload maintenance, clip rotation, and hand swapping. Rotation and retention overlap only at a generic level; there is no tool insertion or response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Four clips rotated at least 80 degrees, back flush within 3 mm/1.5 degrees, hands released, arms returned.
comparison.reason: Tests maintaining spring preload while sequentially closing clips, not selecting a damping setting through repeated impacts.
